contribution.position: Holding my earlier position. I must directly answer qa, who claims per artifact:perf-report that queue_depth is 700 items within a 1000-item budget — that datum does not exist. artifact:perf-report actually states queue_depth measured 4200 items at peak load against a 1000-item budget, so qa's 'risk is contained' claim rests on a misreading of the artifact and should be discounted. The unaddressed facts remain: 4x-over-budget peak queue depth on the load path, plus artifact:incident-log showing both of last quarter's sev2 incidents were retry storms, the exact failure mode sustained queue pressure aggravates. artifact:test-report (412 passed, 87% coverage) does not exercise that load path, and neither ops's runbook nor product's cost headroom speaks to it. No new reliability evidence has appeared since my last turn, so opposition stands; a fix or mitigation for the queue-depth gap would be what changes this position.
